items: 1 package silken tofu or soft tofu

ingredients.title: Sauce
items: 1/2 tsp Gochugaru (Korean chili flakes) or red pepper flakes, optional

steps: Prepare the tofu by soaking up the excess liquid with a paper towel, or by carefully tilting the open package over the sink. Place a serving plate on top of the tofu and transfer it onto the plate.
Combine all sauce ingredients in a bowl and pour it over the tofu. Enjoy!
